title: Vectors: Tunnel authorization test cases
description: Test vectors for tunnel-auth: valid authorization, expired, wrong root, replay (stale path_seq), route hash mismatch, unauthorized inner_src. CBOR + signature bytes for cross-impl validation.
notes: Added independent deterministic tunnel authorization corpus: test/vectors/generate_tunnel_authorization.py (imports PyNaCl-backed reference_schnorr48 only, never production lichen code), tunnel_authorization.json, dedicated strict Draft-07 schema, and Python consumer test_tunnel_auth_vectors.py. Corpus contains 23 signed/malformed messages, 26 POST/state cases, and 13 decapsulation cases covering canonical alg -65537 bytes and every requested identity/key/egress/route/direction/scope/expiry/revocation/replay/clock/root-rotation/prefix/address/malformed/noncanonical/trailing/duplicate/fail-closed boundary. Stable field contract coordinated with Rust hgwq.2 worker, who owns only Rust consumer files. Validation: generator --check and git diff --check pass; dedicated vector consumer 5/5 pass; gateway aggregate 245 passed (2 unrelated existing warnings); Ruff/format clean; strict mypy clean; schema validation and independent signature/intermediate recomputation pass.
close_reason: Independent tunnel authorization corpus, schema, freshness gate, and Python production consumer complete and green
